flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cronservice): workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{jobs/ToppanLettersGeneratorJob,jobs/ToppanUploadJob,helpers/ToppanUploadHelper,models/ToppanStage}, services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl (719-character data file), services/comcryptSftpBlob/helper/ComcryptUploadProcessor, schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler, controllers/ToppanUnifiedController, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository, workflows/furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper, application-prod.properties, cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi: CronProxyService (manual trigger). Other repos: no code specific to this story.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark mentions SFTP and code split. Stage RR3 (3rd reminder on the owner/hirer path; OCMS-DF-2026-170 names RR3 for hirers). The Toppan letter generator processes all stages (RD1 to DR3 and ANL) in one job: it selects due notices for the current offender, builds a 719-character fixed-width data file (no PDF for RR3; PDF only for Advisory Notices), uploads it to Azure Blob and requests COMCRYPT encryption, which is forwarded to the Toppan SFTP. Stricter evidence than the sibling stage trace (OCMS11.7): the call to this job from the day-end scheduler is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118), so in the repo letter generation only runs through POST /toppan/generate-letters (also from the staff portal via CronProxyService.java:226-227; OCMS-DF-2026-192 mentions 'manual letter generation cron in staff portal'). The SFTP upload to Toppan is blocked by config in dev, UAT and prod (sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan, application-prod.properties:86; OCMS-DF-2026-170); while the block is active the delivery gate is bypassed and the stage still advances even though the file is not delivered (ToppanUploadJob.java:422-446; OCMS-DF-2026-192, status Ready to UAT, not in prod). The admin fee is calculated at RR3 (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1817-1840); OCMS-DF-2026-170 and OCMS-SR-2026-171 (closed) fix a wrong $15 fee at stages other than RR3/DR3. The file content at the vendor, Toppan, COMCRYPT and the partner SFTP cannot verify from repo. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ was not used as evidence.
recommendation: Claim partially. Building the RR3 data file up to blob and COMCRYPT exists, but it is not scheduled (manual only) and the SFTP delivery to Toppan is blocked in prod, so the letter does not actually reach the vendor. Confirm with URA when the Toppan block is lifted and whether the job must be scheduled again.

steps.step: The letter generator job runs stage RR3 (3rd reminder) for delivery to the vendor
steps.detail: ToppanLettersGeneratorJob loops over all ToppanStage values (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3, ANL) and calls executeWithStage per stage (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:151-176). But the day-end scheduler (cron.toppanupload.enabled=true, 00:15, cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62) does not call this job: the line is commented out (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118) and executeDayEndJobs only runs auto revival, admin fee and cleanup (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:116-124). The only trigger in the repo is POST /toppan/generate-letters (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34-38), which the staff portal also calls through the proxy (CronProxyService.java:226-227). So Partial: stage RR3 is processed, but not automatically.

steps.step: OCMS selects the hirer notices entitled to the 3rd letter (next stage RR3, due, not suspended)
steps.detail: findToppanNoticesForStage('RR3') joins the VON with ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver where offender_indicator = 'Y' (the current offender, including a furnished hirer set to Y in FurnishApprovalHelper.java:546-558), with WHERE next_processing_stage = stage, next_processing_date <= today, no suspension_type and an_flag not 'Y' (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:608-612). ToppanUploadHelper.getValidOffenceNoticesOptimized uses it (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1875-1884). In addition MID/DIP notices at RR3 are removed and given PS-MID/PS-DIP (extra logic, ToppanUploadHelper.java:1974-1990).

steps.step: The hirer letter address comes from the current letter_address row; notices without one are not sent
steps.detail: The address is chosen from the ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver_addr row with letter_address = 'Y' for the notice + owner_driver_indicator pair (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2190-2200); notices without that row are dropped by filterByLetterAddress (ToppanUploadJob.java:265-267, ToppanUploadHelper.java:2372-2380) without an error. FurnishApprovalHelper gives letter_address = 'Y' to the hirer furnished_mail address (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:626-634), but after every letter Toppan clears that flag and re-sets it with the order mha_reg, lta_reg, lta_mail (ToppanUploadHelper.java:394-410, 500-522), without furnished_mail. For the hirer RR3 letter an address only exists if an mha_reg/lta_* row is available (for example from the UEN sync, OCMS11.41); otherwise the notice is left out of the file and only a log line is written. Real address data cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS builds the 3rd letter data file (data format; PDF/data) with the details for the vendor to print
steps.detail: ToppanUploadJob builds the file name URA-DPT-RR3-D1-<timestamp> and calls createRequestFileContent('TOPPAN_RR3') (ToppanUploadJob.java:278-288). AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl builds a header + a 719-character detail line per notice (current offender name, address, amount) (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:564-566, 648-661). For RR3 the amount = composition + admin fee (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:730-731; fee resolved in ToppanUploadHelper.java:1817-1840). Only the data format exists; PDF is only produced for Advisory Notices, but the story says 'PDF/data', so the data format is enough. OCMS-DF-2026-170/OCMS-SR-2026-171 (closed) fix a wrong $15 admin fee at non-RR3/DR3 stages. The final content on the Toppan side cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The file is stored in Azure Blob and OCMS requests COMCRYPT encryption before sending to the vendor
steps.detail: The original file is uploaded to Azure Blob (uploadProcessor.uploadToBlob, ToppanUploadJob.java:308-318), then comcryptTokenHelper.requestToken is called with the ENCRYPTION operation so the COMCRYPT callback encrypts the file from blob and forwards it to the SFTP (ToppanUploadJob.java:344-358). This step runs even while the SFTP block is active; what fails is the final upload (next step). The COMCRYPT service and per-environment values cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The 3rd letter file is sent to the vendor (Toppan) over SFTP
steps.detail: The COMCRYPT callback encrypts and uploads to the Toppan SFTP through ComcryptUploadProcessor, but the toppan server is blocked: sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in dev, UAT and prod (application-prod.properties:84-86; OCMS-DF-2026-170). ComcryptUploadProcessor throws SftpDisabledException and the operation record is not cleaned up (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:200-212), so the file does not reach the vendor. The delivery gate (120-second poll, cron-schedules-prod.properties:67-73) only waits for that confirmation. Partial because the upload code exists and works for other servers, but for Toppan it is deliberately switched off; when the block is lifted and whether the partner receives the file cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: After sending, the notice is recorded as sent and advanced from RR3 to the next stage (CPC)
steps.detail: confirmDeliveryAndAdvanceStage advances the stage via updateProcessingStage only after delivery is confirmed (OCMS-DEV-2026-199); the RR3 target comes from ocms_stage_map with a CPC fallback (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1805-1823). But when the toppan server is blocked, the gate is bypassed and the stage still advances even though the file was not delivered (ToppanUploadJob.java:422-446), so the notice status can claim the letter was sent when it was not. OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT, not in prod) is the related fix; the result on real data cannot verify from repo.
